g.text: One-time preprocessing turns a 90 MB SkillCorner match into a 4.5 MB bundle. The browser downloads it once and never talks to a server again while scrubbing.
tracking file is 90 MB, via Git LFS
continuous playback clock across half time
int16 positions in cm · un-mirror events
swap the match = change one id
RUN TIME · NEXT.JS APP ON VERCEL
gunzip in browser → typed arrays in memory
time, speed, loop, clip draft, overlays
clip record → encoded in the URL
loops, play button, open in full match
coach or scout opens the link. no login.
Only the bundle is fetched at run time. Clips need no database: the link is the record.
Logos: Simple Icons (CC0). Data: SkillCorner open data (MIT).
